payload.text: Issue 0676: /in-session's releaser records in the session's sentinel the languages it loaded skills for, under one header line; the prompt gate compares that with `intent lang declared` on every prompt that passes and `wb pickup` prints `languages moved:`, each naming both sets and /in-session. A test pins the header across the two scripts and canon::BOOTSTRAP_HEADER. Worktree tmp/wt-ic-0676 stacked on 0650 fix-v3 and 0672 fix-v1. fix-v1 is banked at refs/bank/ic/0676/fix-v1-on-0672v1 (blob bce631c2e5cd, patch_id 57c8bd2d96c9) and asked as 01M7349MXCH6W751Y25QRXP4FX, after 0672's run.
